meta.description: Men's rugby union test matches between two full national sides only (TheSportsDB league 5479, which also carries Rugby Championship fixtures). Tour games against clubs, invitational and "A"/XV sides are filtered out. Team names are stored as the country only (TheSportsDB's " Rugby" suffix removed). No manually-curated history behind this file - it started empty on 2026-09-24 and is built entirely from TheSportsDB, backfilled on its first run.
